canonical_fields.name: chunk_schema_version
canonical_fields.description: Identifies what the chunk record's fields MEAN (this module's version) - distinct from chunk_config_hash, which identifies HOW the chunk was generated.

canonical_fields.name: chunk_uid
canonical_fields.description: Globally unique, deterministic chunk identity across all supported SEC sources - SHA-256 over canonical JSON of {chunk_schema_version, source, document_id, chunk_config_hash, chunk_local_id}. Changes iff any of those five inputs changes.

canonical_fields.name: chunk_local_id
canonical_fields.description: Deterministic identity of the chunk inside its source document, for one chunking configuration - computable from purely local information (no cross-document lookup).

canonical_fields.name: document_id
canonical_fields.description: Canonical source-document identity. Source-specific format (see project_plan/PHASE2_CHUNK_METADATA_SCHEMA.md) - `source` + `document_id` together unambiguously identify the source document.

canonical_fields.name: accession
canonical_fields.description: SEC accession (hyphenated NNNNNNNNNN-NN-NNNNNN) where authoritatively known. NULL for EDGAR-CORPUS (no reliable accession linkage exists) - never fabricated from filename/CIK/year.

canonical_fields.name: cik
canonical_fields.description: SEC Central Index Key - canonical integer, never a zero-padded string.

canonical_fields.name: company
canonical_fields.description: Display company name. Never used as identity (names change/vary) - identity is cik/document_id/accession.

canonical_fields.name: form_type
canonical_fields.description: SEC filing type (e.g. "10-K") - never silently normalized from an amendment or other form.

canonical_fields.name: fiscal_year
canonical_fields.description: Fiscal year, never conflated with filing year.

canonical_fields.name: period_end
canonical_fields.description: Reporting-period end date, where authoritatively known (e.g. from a submission's `period` field). NULL, never a manufactured "Dec 31 of fiscal_year".

canonical_fields.name: filed_date
canonical_fields.description: Actual SEC filing date, where authoritatively known. NULL, never inferred from fiscal_year + an offset.

canonical_fields.name: sic
canonical_fields.description: SEC Standard Industrial Classification code, where available from frozen raw SEC metadata. NULL, never guessed from company name.

canonical_fields.name: section_id
canonical_fields.description: Stable machine-readable section identity (e.g. "item_7"). NULL when a chunk spans/crosses sections or section identity is genuinely ambiguous - never the first heading seen.

canonical_fields.name: section_title
canonical_fields.description: Human-readable section title, where confidently available. NULL rather than synthesized.

canonical_fields.name: ordinal
canonical_fields.description: Zero-based canonical chunk order within the document - never a Parquet/LanceDB physical row number.

canonical_fields.name: char_start
canonical_fields.description: Zero-based, half-open [char_start, char_end) start offset into the canonical document text consumed by the chunker. NULL (with char_end) when no defensible contiguous span exists.

canonical_fields.name: char_end
canonical_fields.description: Half-open interval end (exclusive). NULL (with char_start) when no defensible contiguous span exists - never an approximate/source-dependent offset.

canonical_fields.name: content_type
canonical_fields.description: One of CONTENT_TYPES: prose | table | table_summary.

canonical_fields.name: table_id
canonical_fields.description: Deterministic table identity (Task 2.8's table-identity contract, reused where available). Required when content_type is table/table_summary; NULL is normal for prose.

canonical_fields.name: source
canonical_fields.description: One of SOURCE_VALUES: edgar_corpus | primary. MS MARCO is never a value here - it is a separate benchmark track.

canonical_fields.name: text
canonical_fields.description: The actual retrieval text - never the embedding vector, never the full source document, never metadata appended into the string.

canonical_fields.name: token_count
canonical_fields.description: Token count per the chunking configuration's own tokenizer - never recomputed with an unrelated tokenizer during validation.

canonical_fields.name: chunk_config_hash
canonical_fields.description: Opaque semantic identity of the chunking configuration (SHA-256 hex, this project's convention). Task 2.9 validates format/presence only - Task 2.10 owns how it is computed/matched across artifacts.

chunk_uid_algorithm: SHA-256 over canonical JSON of {chunk_schema_version, source, document_id, chunk_config_hash, chunk_local_id}
chunk_local_id_contract: document-local, computable without cross-document information; format "chunk{ordinal:06d}" or "{section_id}:chunk{ordinal:06d}"
offset_contract: zero-based, half-open [char_start, char_end); both-NULL or both-populated; NULL when no defensible contiguous span exists

primary_compatibility.note: chunk_config_hash and token_count in this sample are audit-only placeholders (Task 2.9 does not build a real Phase 3 chunking configuration or tokenizer pipeline) - see project_plan/PHASE2_CHUNK_METADATA_SCHEMA.md.

known_limitations: Phase 1 chunks: char_start/char_end were computed transiently during chunking but never persisted in the frozen artifact - honestly NULL, not re-derived by rechunking.
Phase 1 chunks: section_id is NULL (fixed-window chunking is section-oblivious) and accession/period_end/filed_date/sic are NULL (no accession linkage exists for EDGAR-CORPUS).
Primary sample: char_start/char_end are NULL - Docling's HTML backend has no byte/char source provenance (documented in Task 2.8).
Primary sample: chunk_config_hash and token_count are audit-only placeholders, not a real Phase 3 chunking configuration/tokenizer.
Task 2.8's 45,769 would-be-gold evidence facts remain status quo - Task 2.9 does not promote them; chunk_recall@10/chunk_mrr's available_for_current_gold remain false.
